sentences.en: I cannot conceive why she has done such a thing.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象她为什么会这么做。

sentences.en: She is happy to have conceived a baby by him.
sentences.zh: 她很高兴能和他有了孩子。

sentences.en: I conceived of the plan while I was smoking.
sentences.zh: 我在抽烟的时候想出了这个计划。
